data.name: Usage
data.value: Usage: ForgeFlow.Bootstrap initialize-deployment | reset-password (no additional arguments).

data.name: InteractiveRequired
data.value: An interactive private terminal is required.

data.name: ConnectionRequired
data.value: Set FORGEFLOW_BOOTSTRAP_SQLSERVER privately to the dedicated provisioning connection.

data.name: OperatorResponsibility
data.value: Only the deployment owner/operator may initialize this inspected installation. Use separate provisioning credentials. Password input is hidden. Do not record the terminal session.

data.name: Confirmation
data.value: Type INITIALIZE to confirm your operator responsibility and target:

data.name: OperationId
data.value: Operation ID (blank creates a new ID; reuse the ID to resolve an uncertain result):

data.name: Failure
data.value: Initialization failed. Check prerequisites with the deployment operator. Reference: {0}

data.name: RecoveryConnectionRequired
data.value: Set FORGEFLOW_RECOVERY_SQLSERVER privately to the dedicated recovery provisioning connection.

data.name: RecoveryResponsibility
data.value: Only the responsible host operator may recover an account. Verify the account owner out of band and supervise their private password entry. Recovery does not restore disabled access or grant authority. Do not record this terminal session.

data.name: RecoveryConfirmation
data.value: Type RECOVER to attest that you verified the account owner and recovery target:
